bluf: eology is a German online marketing agency in Volkach, with Würzburg and Hamburg offices, selling visibility in search and AI answers: SEO and GEO, content, outreach, performance and social. It is doing AI visibility in earnest: a GEO audit product, a ChatGPT Ads page with a launch post dated 31 Aug 2026, llms.txt, 48 AI search URLs and a DMEXCO 2026 stand. The record says it is going deeper into AI answers and AI assisted production, with an undated press item on new management as the one governance move. The thing a rival should know: it shows no ads of its own and no public price.
doing:
eology positions itself as an online marketing agency creating visibility in search and AI answers through SEO and GEO, content creation, outreach, performance and social. In plain words: a German SEO and content shop rebuilt around AI answer visibility, selling the audit, the placement and now the ads. Its H1 reads WE CREATE (AI) VISIBILITY and its headline claim is a case in which targeted content placement lifted BENKERT BÄNKE's mentions and visibility in generative AI answers.

The sold mix leads with AI search and GEO (scored 3: GEO audit, AI Visibility and ChatGPT Ads services, LLM visibility cases) and SEO (scored 3: SEO & GEO is the first homepage pillar, with SEO cases for Braun Hamburg and Lexware). Four lines score 2: AI automation (AI assisted content and imagery, a DEPOT AI content optimisation case, a job posting for an AI content engineer), content and digital PR (outreach cases for Lexware, HSE and Josera seeding), creator and influencer (an AmbienteDirect influencer campaign, Raiffeisenbank social content) and paid search (SEA inside performance marketing, a Customer Match acquisition case, an SEA manager hire). Proprietary lines are the GEO Audit and a Content Zertifizierung certification offer; the record lists no partners.

AI posture is the lead: GEO audits, brand placement in the sources LLMs cite, ChatGPT Ads, and AI assisted content and image production. Moves in date order: 2026-08, the ChatGPT Ads agency page went live with a German launch news post dated 31 Aug 2026; 2026-09, it exhibited at DMEXCO 2026 in Cologne (Hall 8, 23 and 24 September); undated, a press item on new management, with the team page listing three managing directors. Pricing signals: none. Conspicuously absent for a search agency of its kind: any feed, schema or entity work, any CRM, CRO or web build line (each scored 0), and data and measurement at only 1 for a shop selling AI visibility measurement.
clients:
The record types the client base as mixed, with verticals of ecommerce and retail, banking and furniture, and a German home market: offices in Volkach, Würzburg and Hamburg, and 59 named staff across the German and English team pages as a floor.

The needs read lists 11 clients, all 11 observed and 0 named only, from 2 case studies and 9 case study slugs. The computed read codes every one under local and lead generation (share 0.705), with organic demand (0.136), social and creators (0.102) and paid performance (0.057) alongside; the slugs describe the work more precisely. BENKERT BÄNKE came for AI search placement (a KI case on targeted content placement in AI search) and DEPOT for AI content optimisation. Lexware came for content strategy, misterlady for content creation, HSE for content outreach and Josera for seeding. AmbienteDirect came for an influencer marketing campaign and Raiffeisenbank for a social media content strategy, both also coded social and creators. Braun Hamburg and kinoundco came for SEO strategy, coded organic demand. Wilson came for performance marketing, coded paid performance. No client sits on another tracked agency's book, so nothing in this record is shared.

What the base needs next: the Horus read places eology best for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them), driven by its AI search line, and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out). It is likely, with moderate confidence, that this retail heavy German book will buy AI answer placement and ChatGPT ad tests next, and that the SEO retainers behind Braun Hamburg and kinoundco are the hours most at risk from the hollowing.

openings:
The strongest opening is the machine readable layer. eology sells AI visibility at depth yet the record holds no feed, schema or entity work on its core search line: the layer answer engines consume is unclaimed by the agency that leads with answer engines. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival packaging entity and feed work with a citation share number can win the ecommerce and retail accounts (DEPOT, AmbienteDirect, misterlady) that already buy AI content from it. Falsifier: an eology service page or case describing schema, feed or entity work.

Second, no public pricing model, and its P8 posture is partial: it talks ChatGPT Ads with no incrementality or holdout capability showing, so a rival pricing assistant ad tests on outputs, with holdouts, holds a conversation eology cannot hold in public. Third, the KJ6 exposure driven by SEO: the retainers behind Braun Hamburg and kinoundco are hours the hollowing removes, so an AI operator delivery model undercuts them, though the Monsoon Breeze band (52.0) says price alone is unlikely to move this book. Fourth, no own ads visible on a site selling performance marketing, with the caveat that the Google lookup was blocked rather than empty.
